description: Read contract-reported token identity, metadata, supply and limited control facts at one pinned finalized Base block. No safety score, honeypot/trading simulation, verified-source claim or inferred absence of privileges. Missing or deceptive getter evidence remains unknown/not_assessed. $0.010000 USDC per call on Base (eip155:8453), via an approved compatible client. Persist original proof/input and REQUIRED random32-byte private recovery token: REST X-Fresh402-Recovery-Token; MCP params._meta['fresh402/recovery-token']. Reuse originals for recovery with no new RPC/debit; foreign snapshots/cursors are not usable. Provider failure/partial scan is not paid success. observation_saved=false with persistence_error means pending domain finalization: recover only, do not use unsaved IDs. Prepaid needs eligible finalized all-service credits or an original explicit service-specific tariff4 grant; inspect /v3/prepaid/quote/token_facts. Historical Web rights unchanged; paying agents do not need their own RPC credentials. Read /v3/prepaid/all-services for explicit terms. Observations retain30days; private financial recovery7days. Not complete history, financial advice or a security audit. Optional free trial: inspect /v3/agent-trial (unfunded EOA ownership signature, no CAPTCHA); Web tools also support the separate human trial at /v2/trial. Eligibility and shared capacity apply;429 may precede quota exhaustion. Send only X-Fresh402-Trial-Key plus a persisted Idempotency-Key per logical REST/MCP call; reuse the same tool/input/key for retained recovery. Exhaustion never authorizes a charge.

address.description: 20-byte Ethereum address; lowercase/uppercase accepted, mixed case must have a valid EIP-55 checksum. Normalized to checksummed form.

block.description: Finalized only. Every state read pins the selected block hash with requireCanonical:true; no latest/number fallback.
